profile.headline: Advisory Software Engineer at IBM
profile.summary: AIX, Fibre Channel Storage and SAN Technology Professional, with 13+ years experience in AIX System Administration and SANs, and 10+ years experience in storage device drivers.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description: AIX Development Support Specialist with focus area in AIX I/O device drivers and configuration methods.  Support enterprise customers worldwide on AIX and VIOS systems, providing solutions for a wide variety of different storage and SAN related issues -  from configuration issues and hardware issues, to newly discovered AIX issues.  Where an AIX defect is determined to be the source of a customer issue, debug the defective AIX source code down to the broken line of code or broken module, and provided advice on coding corrections for the problem.  Technical Team Lead for the AIX I/O Device Driver Team.
positions.insights: Storage Area Network (SAN), Unix and +2 skills

positions.title: AIX System Admin/ SAN Admin
positions.description: Provided daily systems administration for AIX systems.  Also provided Windows Servers support.  Provided EMC SAN administration, including storage provisioning, capacity planning, lun mapping, zoning, configuration to both AIX and Windows hosts, Scripting of Timefinder BCV's and SRDF operations.  Team Lead for major Migration project from Windows servers to AIX servers, which also included migration of multiple enterprise databases to a new storage array.  Responsible for creation of migration plan, testing, and full implementation of same.

positions.title: Data Processing Coordinator
positions.description: Daily systems administration of AIX system, Linux e-mail server, plus desktop support for local office in Amarillo, Texas and satellite office in Hereford, Texas. Leader of Automation Team.
